mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RENT_CTRT rc JOIN MEMBER m ON m.USER_NO = rc.USER_NO JOIN RENT_LISTING rl ON rl.RENT_LSTG_NO = rc.RENT_LSTG_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_no, apt_cmplex_no FROM ( SELECT rr.USER_NO, rr.APT_CMPLEX_NO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rr.USER_NO ORDER BY rr.RCPT_DT DESC) AS rn FROM RESIDENT_RQST rr ) WHERE rn = 1 ) rr1 ON rr1.USER_NO = rc.USER_NO LEFT JOIN APT_COMPLEX ac ON ac.APT_CMPLEX_NO = rr1.APT_CMPLEX_NO WHERE 1=1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rc.REG_DT DESC) AS rn, rc.RENT_CTRT_NO AS rentCtrtNo, rl.RENT_TYPE_CD AS rentTypeCd, m.USER_ID AS userId, rr1.APT_CMPLEX_NO AS aptCmplexNo, rc.REG_DT AS regDt, rc.CTRT_STTS_CD AS ctrtSttsCd FROM RENT_CTRT rc JOIN MEMBER m ON m.USER_NO = rc.USER_NO JOIN RENT_LISTING rl ON rl.RENT_LSTG_NO = rc.RENT_LSTG_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_no, apt_cmplex_no FROM ( SELECT rr.USER_NO, rr.APT_CMPLEX_NO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rr.USER_NO ORDER BY rr.RCPT_DT DESC) AS rn FROM RESIDENT_RQST rr ) WHERE rn = 1 ) rr1 ON rr1.USER_NO = rc.USER_NO WHERE 1=1
) WHERE rn BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ORDER BY rn DESC
